items.title: Bitcoin below $77,000, Zcash leads losses as traders bet on a Fed rate hike
items.summary: Ninety-five of the CoinDesk 100 fell over the past 24 hours, and bitcoin has shed more than 5% on the week.

items.title: Brevo login flaw enabled phishing email targeting 347K Trezor subscribers
items.summary: Trezor told Cointelegraph that the phishing email was sent to 347,000 subscribers and said it is treating every address as “known to the attacker and possibly reusable for phishing.”

items.title: Sam Bankman-Fried asks Supreme Court to overturn fraud conviction and $11 billion forfeiture
items.summary: Bankman-Fried says he was unfairly barred from providing evidence that FTX had more than enough assets to cover losses from the collapse.

items.title: Senate Republicans Release Revised Clarity Act Ahead of September 15 Vote
items.summary: The draft adds registration requirements for controlled trading protocols and leaves its ethics provisions largely unchanged.
